passages.title: Text 01
passages.text: Riko puts on his raincoat. He takes an umbrella before going outside.

passages.title: Text 02
passages.text: Lia blows out the candles on a cake. Her family sings for her.

passages.title: Text 03
passages.text: Beni rubs his eyes and yawns. He gets into bed.

passages.title: Text 04
passages.text: Nana opens her bag. There is no pencil inside. She asks her friend, 'Can I use yours?'

passages.title: Text 05
passages.text: The dog runs to its empty bowl. Its owner opens a bag of dog food. The dog looks at the bag and barks.

passages.title: Text 06
passages.text: Siti wears a thick jacket and gloves. She says, 'My hands are still cold.'

passages.title: Text 07
passages.text: Dad turns off the lights. The family sits on the sofa and looks at the TV.

passages.title: Text 08
passages.text: Tomi looks at the clock. He grabs his school bag and runs to the door.

passages.title: Text 09
passages.text: Mila tastes the soup and quickly drinks a glass of water. 'Too spicy!' she says.

passages.title: Text 10
passages.text: The classroom is quiet. Everyone opens a book. The teacher says, 'Start reading now.'

passages.title: Text 11
passages.text: Ari takes a wet towel from his bag. His hair is wet, and he is wearing swimming goggles.

passages.title: Text 12
passages.text: Rina looks at the empty bus stop. The bus is moving away. She says, 'Oh no!'

passages.title: Text 13
passages.text: Niko opens the fridge. There is no milk. He writes 'milk' on a small shopping list.

passages.title: Text 14
passages.text: Lala holds a gift behind her back. She smiles when her friend walks into the room.

passages.title: Text 15
passages.text: The floor is wet near the sink. Dodi takes a cloth and kneels beside it.

passages.title: Text 16
passages.text: Fani has a ticket for the 10 a.m. train. It is 9:55, and she is still outside the station. She starts running.

passages.title: Text 17
passages.text: The sky is dark. Wind blows the leaves. Dad takes the clothes off the line.

passages.title: Text 18
passages.text: Mira is holding an ice cream. It starts to drip onto her hand. She eats it quickly.

passages.title: Text 19
passages.text: The shop sign says 'CLOSED.' A worker is putting chairs on the tables and turning off the lights.

passages.title: Text 20
passages.text: Rafi sees his little sister standing by a high shelf. She points to a toy at the top. Rafi reaches up and takes it down.

questions.prompt: What is the weather probably like?
questions.evidence: Riko puts on his raincoat. He takes an umbrella before going outside.
questions.explanation: Jas hujan dan payung memberi petunjuk bahwa kemungkinan sedang hujan.

questions.evidence: Lia blows out the candles on a cake. Her family sings for her.
questions.explanation: Lilin di kue dan keluarga yang bernyanyi menunjukkan perayaan ulang tahun.

questions.evidence: Beni rubs his eyes and yawns. He gets into bed.
questions.explanation: Menguap dan naik ke tempat tidur menunjukkan Beni mengantuk.

questions.evidence: There is no pencil inside. She asks her friend, 'Can I use yours?'
questions.explanation: Pensilnya tidak ada sehingga kemungkinan ia ingin meminjam pensil temannya.

questions.prompt: What does the dog probably want?
questions.evidence: The dog runs to its empty bowl. Its owner opens a bag of dog food. The dog looks at the bag and barks.
questions.explanation: Mangkuknya kosong dan anjing melihat kantong makanan anjing yang dibuka pemiliknya; kemungkinan ia ingin makan.

questions.prompt: What is the weather probably like?
questions.evidence: Siti wears a thick jacket and gloves. She says, 'My hands are still cold.'
questions.explanation: Jaket tebal, sarung tangan, dan tangan yang dingin menunjukkan cuaca dingin.

questions.prompt: What will the family probably do?
questions.evidence: The family sits on the sofa and looks at the TV.
questions.explanation: Duduk menghadap televisi menunjukkan mereka akan menonton.

choices: He may be late for school.
questions.evidence: Tomi looks at the clock. He grabs his school bag and runs to the door.
questions.explanation: Melihat jam lalu bergegas membawa tas sekolah menunjukkan ia mungkin terlambat.

choices: She wants to wash the bowl.
The soup is too spicy for her.
questions.evidence: Mila tastes the soup and quickly drinks a glass of water. 'Too spicy!' she says.
questions.explanation: Ia minum setelah mencicipi sup yang terasa terlalu pedas.

questions.prompt: What are the students probably doing?
questions.evidence: The classroom is quiet. Everyone opens a book. The teacher says, 'Start reading now.'
questions.explanation: Kelas tenang, buku dibuka, dan guru menyuruh membaca menunjukkan kegiatan membaca.

questions.prompt: What has Ari probably just done?
questions.evidence: Ari takes a wet towel from his bag. His hair is wet, and he is wearing swimming goggles.
questions.explanation: Rambut basah, handuk basah, dan kacamata renang mengarah pada kegiatan berenang.

choices: Rina is already on the bus.
The bus is waiting for her.
questions.evidence: Rina looks at the empty bus stop. The bus is moving away. She says, 'Oh no!'
questions.explanation: Bus sudah menjauh saat Rina di halte; kemungkinan ia ketinggalan bus.

questions.evidence: There is no milk. He writes 'milk' on a small shopping list.
questions.explanation: Susu habis dan ditulis dalam daftar belanja, jadi kemungkinan Niko akan membelinya.

choices: To surprise her friend with a gift.
questions.evidence: Lala holds a gift behind her back. She smiles when her friend walks into the room.
questions.explanation: Hadiah disembunyikan dan Lala tersenyum ketika temannya datang; kemungkinan ia menyiapkan kejutan.

questions.evidence: The floor is wet near the sink. Dodi takes a cloth and kneels beside it.
questions.explanation: Lantai basah dan Dodi mengambil kain; kemungkinan ia akan mengelap air.

choices: She wants to catch her train.
She wants to buy a new ticket tomorrow.
She wants to walk home slowly.
She wants to miss the train.
questions.evidence: Fani has a ticket for the 10 a.m. train. It is 9:55, and she is still outside the station. She starts running.
questions.explanation: Kereta berangkat lima menit lagi sementara Fani masih di luar stasiun, sehingga ia bergegas mengejar kereta.

questions.prompt: Why does Dad probably take the clothes off the line?
choices: He wants to wash them again.
He thinks it may rain soon.
He wants to hang more clothes.
questions.evidence: The sky is dark. Wind blows the leaves. Dad takes the clothes off the line.
questions.explanation: Langit gelap dan angin memberi petunjuk hujan mungkin segera turun; ayah mengamankan pakaian.

choices: Her ice cream is frozen solid.
She wants to put it in a bag.
questions.evidence: It starts to drip onto her hand. She eats it quickly.
questions.explanation: Es krim menetes karena mencair; Mira makan cepat agar tidak semakin meleleh.

questions.prompt: What is probably happening at the shop?
choices: It is closing for the day.
questions.evidence: The shop sign says 'CLOSED.' A worker is putting chairs on the tables and turning off the lights.
questions.explanation: Tulisan tutup, kursi diangkat, dan lampu dimatikan menunjukkan toko sedang ditutup.

questions.prompt: Why does Rafi take down the toy?
choices: He wants to hide it from her.
He wants to clean the shelf.
questions.evidence: Rafi sees his little sister standing by a high shelf. She points to a toy at the top. Rafi reaches up and takes it down.
questions.explanation: Adik menunjuk mainan di rak tinggi dan Rafi mengambilkannya; kemungkinan adiknya tidak bisa menjangkaunya.
